note: Многокадровые сцены для замера КОНСИСТЕНТНОСТИ. Отличие от briefs.json: там одиночные клипы и покадровый реализм, здесь герой обязан повторяться минимум в двух кадрах — иначе сравнивать нечего. Кадры у обоих плеч ОДИНАКОВЫЕ; разница только в том, несёт ли промт единый канон героя.

scenes.title: Мальчик и алабай

cast.canonical: 7-year-old Kazakh boy, sun-bleached tousled hair, oversized grey knitted sweater, bare feet, childlike gait
white Central Asian shepherd dog (alabai), cropped ears, heavy build, dark patch over the left eye

shots.description: The boy runs through tall feather grass at dawn, the dog bounding beside him.
shots.soundscape: wind in grass, bare feet on soil, dog panting

shots.description: Close-up: the boy kneels and hugs the dog around the neck, laughing.
shots.soundscape: child's laughter, dog collar jingle, distant birds

shots.description: Wide shot: the dog runs alone toward the horizon, the boy watching from the foreground.
shots.soundscape: wind, paws on dry ground, one short bark

scenes.why: Оба героя во всех трёх кадрах, включая крупный план и общий — дрейф лица и окраса виден сразу.

scenes.title: Бабушка и чай

cast.canonical: Kazakh woman about 70, deep wrinkles, age spots on hands, dark blue headscarf with small white pattern, warm squint

shots.description: The woman pours tea from a copper kettle into a piala; steam rises in a sunbeam.
shots.soundscape: pouring tea, fire crackle, dense room tone

shots.description: Close-up of her face as she blows on the tea and smiles at someone off-camera.
She stands at the yurt entrance holding the piala, looking out at the steppe.
shots.soundscape: wind at the doorway, fabric moving

scenes.why: Один герой, три разные крупности и разный свет — самый чистый тест на устойчивость лица.

scenes.title: Беркутчи и беркут

cast.canonical: Kazakh man about 45, weathered face, short black beard, fox-fur hat, brown leather gauntlet on the right arm
golden eagle, dark brown plumage with pale golden nape, yellow cere, leather jesses on both legs

shots.description: The hunter raises his gauntleted arm; the eagle sits on it, turning its head.
The eagle takes off with two heavy wing beats, the hunter leaning back from the force.
shots.soundscape: heavy wing beats, gust, man's grunt

shots.description: Close-up of the hunter's face watching the sky, then the eagle returns into frame.
shots.camera: close-up 85mm then rack focus to sky
shots.soundscape: wind, single eagle cry with natural echo

scenes.why: Человек и птица вместе: у птицы дрейфует оперение и посадка головы, у человека — борода и шапка.
